info.description: Bounded simulator subset of the official AWS Elemental MediaLive API (2017-10-14). Every other official operation returns HTTP 501 UnknownOperationException. Input security groups, networks, SDI sources and channels are stored records: a channel stays IDLE with no pipeline, encoder, egress endpoint or output, and no input, device, cluster or multiplex exists. StartChannel, StopChannel, RestartChannelPipelines, UpdateChannelClass, schedule actions, inputs and partner inputs (their push destinations and pull credentials), input devices, clusters, nodes, channel placement groups, multiplexes, signal maps, the CloudWatch alarm and EventBridge rule templates and groups (whose group template counts the catalog cannot maintain), offerings and reservations (purchases), thumbnails, alerts, account configuration and ListVersions return UnknownOperationException with HTTP 501. Channels cannot attach inputs, so InputAttachments, Vpc, AnywhereSettings, Reserved and DryRun true are refused. Any stream name, user name or password parameter anywhere in Destinations or EncoderSettings is refused because the catalog stores no stream key or credential reference; the official model requires none of the channel members, so a channel with no encoder settings is accepted where AWS demands them. Role ARNs and S3 or RTMP destination URLs are stored without being resolved or contacted. Input security groups are IDLE with no inputs and accept IPv4 CIDR whitelist rules; UpdateInputSecurityGroup changes the rules and refuses Tags (use CreateTags and DeleteTags). Networks are IDLE with no associated clusters, and their CIDRs must be IPv4 ranges. Update operations replace the supplied members whole. Limits per Region are simulator limits, not AWS quotas.
